title: Binary Blocks
tagline: Flip the bits to match the falling numbers.

controls.keyboard: 1-8 flip bits, Space lock, Backspace clear

description: Decimal numbers fall toward the ground. Flip the eight bit switches (128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1) until your byte equals a falling number, then lock it to blow the block up. Chain hits for a combo; the numbers start small and grow up to 255 as the levels rise.
